def issues(value):
    # ruleid: lintro.python.none-coercion.none-guard-return
    if value is not None:
        return value.issues
    return []


def predicate(value):
    # ok: lintro.python.none-coercion.none-guard-return
    if value is not None:
        return True
    return False


def fail_safe(value):
    # ok: lintro.python.none-coercion.none-guard-return
    if value is not None:
        return True
    return []


def explicit_unknown(value):
    # ok: lintro.python.none-coercion.none-guard-return
    if value is not None:
        return value.issues
    return None
